observed_behavior: Gwen completeness terminated with ENOBUFS before reporting a vector.
expected_behavior: Valid source sets larger than 64 MiB can be compared to their committed bytes.
causal_mechanism: One cat-file batch returned all source blobs into a fixed 64 MiB subprocess output buffer.

anti_pattern.structural_description: A fixed transport capacity was imposed on a variable aggregate source set.
anti_pattern.why_it_fails: Valid repository inputs can exceed that capacity independently of graph correctness.

correct_pattern.required_invariant: The buffer admits every expected source byte and Git framing while byte equality remains mandatory.
correct_pattern.implementation_description: Calculate capacity from already loaded UTF-8 source bytes and per-path framing overhead.

known_non_matches: Malformed or uncommitted source remains invalid.
confirmation_evidence: Gwen stack identified committedInputs and captured more than 64 MiB; the multibyte CLI regression reproduced ENOBUFS before correction.
regression_proofs: tests/traceability-completeness.test.ts: commit binding accepts source bytes exceeding the former 64 MiB batch limit
